channel.title: DigitalShelf Labs
channel.description: 2027 planners and a rental property spreadsheet for small landlords from DigitalShelf Labs.

item.title: Plan 2027 on Paper at Your Desk and on Your Tablet on the Go
item.description: The 2027 Planner Bundle gives you printable pages and a hyperlinked tablet PDF in the same calm design. Print the Minimal Planner for your desk, open the Digital Planner in a PDF annotation app when you're out, and keep the same monthly layout in both. Monday or Sunday start, A4, A5 and US Letter printables.

item.title: See All 12 Months of 2027 Before You Plan a Single Week
item.description: The 2027 Minimal Planner opens with a year overview and a year at a glance, so you can mark trips, deadlines and birthdays before you start on the monthly and weekly pages. Clean lines, lots of white space, prints well at home. Year overview, monthly spreads and 53 weekly pages. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Multiple Rental Property Spreadsheet: Compare Up to 10 Units on One Dashboard
item.description: Own more than one rental? This multiple rental property spreadsheet puts up to 10 units side by side: rent expected and collected this month, what's owed, rent received and expenses for the year, net per unit, open repairs and lease alerts. Shared costs get their own line. Units can be grouped by property, one currency per file. More than 10 units? Use one copy per property group. Standard .xlsx with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.

item.title: 4 Dates to Mark First on Your 2027 Calendar
item.description: Start the year with a quick pass over the whole calendar: 1. trips and time off, 2. work or school deadlines, 3. birthdays and anniversaries, 4. school breaks. With all of 2027 on one page you'll spot clashes early. Download the free one-page calendar and print it today. Free download: 4 PDFs, A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. No holidays printed, so it works in any country.

item.title: New Year Planning: Start 2027 With Six Clear Goals, Not a Vague Resolution
item.description: Write up to six goals for 2027 with a deadline, why each one matters and your first steps. Then pick your top 3 goals each month and track the habits that move them forward. All of it is in the Goals & Habits Planner inside the 2027 Planner Bundle, alongside the Minimal and Digital planners.

item.title: Printing Tip: A5 Planner Pages Fit Two to an A4 Sheet
item.description: Want a smaller planner? The 2027 Minimal Planner includes A5 files, and two A5 pages fit side by side on one landscape A4 sheet. Use your printer's two-pages-per-sheet setting, then cut or fold. A4 and US Letter files are included too, each with Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Landlord Maintenance Tracker: Recurring Jobs and a Repairs Log With Overdue Flags
item.description: A rental property maintenance log inside a landlord spreadsheet. Add recurring jobs, for example heating service, smoke and CO alarm tests or gutter cleaning, set how often they repeat in months, and the tracker works out the next due date: amber within 30 days, red when overdue. Repairs get a contractor, cost, status and follow-up date. Check your local rules for which checks are required. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.

item.title: Check In on Your 2027 Goals Every Quarter With a One-Page Review
item.description: Four quarterly reviews in the Goals & Habits Planner: rate your progress on each yearly goal from 0 to 100%, note the highlights, decide what you'll change and set your focus for the next quarter. Part of the 2027 Planner Bundle with the Minimal and Digital planners. Printable A4, A5 and US Letter.

item.title: Plan, Track and Review 2027: Weekly Pages, Habit Trackers and a Linked Digital Year
item.description: A simple 2027 system in three planners. Plan each week on the printable Minimal Planner, track habits and review your month in the Goals & Habits Planner, and keep the whole year one tap away in the hyperlinked Digital Planner. Same calm design across all three. Printables in A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start for every planner.

item.title: A 2027 Weekly Planner Page With Room for All Seven Days
item.description: Each week of 2027 gets its own page: your top 3 for the week, a box for every day and space for notes. 53 weekly pages in the 2027 Minimal Planner, so every day of the year is covered, including the few days of 2026 and 2028 in the first and last weeks. Year overview, monthly spreads and 53 weekly pages. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Rental Income and Expense Tracker Spreadsheet: Rent, Costs and Net Income per Unit
item.description: Track rental income and expenses in one spreadsheet. Log rent as it arrives and every cost by unit and category, such as mortgage interest, repairs, insurance or utilities, or mark it 'Shared' for portfolio-wide costs. The dashboard shows rent received, expenses and net income for the year, per unit and in total. Any currency, no bank connection, no subscription. Standard .xlsx for 1–10 units, with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.

item.title: Monday or Sunday Start? Get Both in This Free 2027 Calendar
item.description: Some people read a week from Monday, some from Sunday. This free 2027 one-page calendar comes in both, in A4 and US Letter, so the week looks the way you expect. Print the one you like and plan the whole year on one page. Free download: 4 PDFs, A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. No holidays printed, so it works in any country.

item.title: What's Inside the 2027 Planner Bundle: Minimal, Goals & Habits and Digital Planners
item.description: Three 2027 planners in one download. The Minimal Planner covers your year, months and 53 weeks. The Goals & Habits Planner holds yearly goals, habit trackers and monthly and quarterly reviews. The Digital Planner is a hyperlinked landscape PDF for tablets. 14 PDFs, A4, A5 and US Letter for the printables, Monday or Sunday start for all three.

item.title: Every Month of 2027 Opens With a Two-Page Spread
item.description: On the left, the month calendar. On the right, blank Holidays and Birthdays fields, your priorities and notes. No country's holidays are printed, so you add the ones you celebrate. Print double-sided to keep each spread facing. 2027 Minimal Planner, printable PDF. Year overview, monthly spreads and 53 weekly pages. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for Tax Time: Annual Income and Expense Summary per Unit
item.description: Tax season and a pile of receipts? This rental property spreadsheet builds an Annual Summary of rent received and costs by category for each unit, and every expense row has a note for where its receipt is saved, so you can share clear totals with your accountant. Categories are generic and not tied to any country's tax form. Record-keeping tool only, not tax or accounting advice. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units.

item.title: Three Places to Keep a One-Page 2027 Calendar: Desk, Fridge or Binder
item.description: A one-page calendar works best where you'll see it every day. Pin it above your desk for deadlines, stick it on the fridge for family dates and school breaks, or keep it in the front of your binder for planning. This one is free. Free download: 4 PDFs, A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. No holidays printed, so it works in any country.

item.title: Minimalist 2027 Planner Printable Set: Clean Black and White Pages for the Whole Year
item.description: Quiet 2027 planner pages with thin black lines, plenty of white space and a small soft illustration each month. A year overview, monthly spreads, weekly pages, goals and habit trackers that print well at home. Part of the 2027 Planner Bundle with the Minimal, Goals & Habits and Digital planners.

item.title: 2027 Monthly Planner Printable in A4, A5 and US Letter: One Clean Layout, Three Sizes
item.description: The same 2027 monthly calendar pages in three paper sizes: A4, A5 and US Letter. Each month is a two-page spread with the month grid, then blank holidays, birthdays, priorities and notes fields, so it works in any country. Print the whole year or only the months you need, at 100% size.

item.title: Security Deposit Tracker for Landlords: Amounts Held, Deductions and Refunds
item.description: A security deposit tracker inside a full landlord spreadsheet. Record the deposit held for each tenant, any deductions and refunds, and see what you still owe back. Rules on deposits differ by country and region, so check your local rules; this is a record-keeping tool, not legal advice. Also tracks rent, lease ends and repairs for 1–10 units. Standard .xlsx.

item.title: Free 2027 Calendar Printable: All 12 Months on One Page
item.description: See the whole of 2027 on one sheet of paper. Pin it above your desk, stick it on the fridge or keep it in the front of a binder, and mark trips, deadlines, birthdays and school breaks at a glance. Weekends are in lighter grey so weekdays stand out. Free download: 4 PDFs, A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. No holidays printed, so it works in any country.

item.title: 2027 Planner Bundle: Printable Minimal Planner, Goals & Habits Planner and Digital Planner
item.description: All three 2027 planners in one download: plan the month and week on paper, set goals and track habits, and carry the year on your tablet. You get the Minimal Planner and Goals & Habits Planner in A4, A5 and US Letter, plus the hyperlinked Digital Planner, all with Monday or Sunday start and the same calm design. 14 PDFs, instant download.

item.title: 2027 Weekly Planner Printable: One Page per Week, Monday or Sunday Start
item.description: Plan one week at a time with 53 weekly pages that cover every day of 2027, including the week that starts in late December 2026. Each page has the dates, a top 3 for the week, space for all seven days and notes. Part of the 2027 Minimal Planner, in A4, A5 and US Letter.

item.title: Lease Expiration Tracker: See Which Leases End in the Next 30, 60 or 90 Days
item.description: A lease expiration tracker that pulls end dates from your leases and groups them into the next 30, 60 and 90 days, with a notice-due flag based on the notice period you enter. Part of a rental property spreadsheet with rent, deposits, repairs and expenses. Notice periods differ by place, so check your local rules. Not legal advice. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units.

item.title: Free 2027 Year-at-a-Glance Calendar in A4 and US Letter
item.description: Pick your paper: A4 for most of the world, US Letter for the US and Canada. Both sizes come with a Monday-start and a Sunday-start version, and every date is checked. Print at 100% / actual size on plain paper, in black and white or colour. Free download: 4 PDFs, A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. No holidays printed, so it works in any country.

item.title: Landlord Spreadsheet: Stop Chasing Rent Across Bank Apps, Emails and Notes
item.description: If your rental records live in bank apps, emails and sticky notes, this landlord spreadsheet puts them in one file: units, tenants, rent ledger, deposits, expenses, repairs and an annual summary of income and costs you can share with your accountant. Built for 1–10 long-term units. Your data stays in your own file. Not legal, tax or accounting advice.

item.title: 2027 Weekly Planner Printable: 53 Weekly Pages With Top 3, Seven Days and Notes
item.description: One page per week, every week of 2027, including the week that starts in late December 2026. Each weekly page has the dates, a top 3 for the week, space for all seven days and notes. Part of the 2027 Minimal Planner with year overview and monthly spreads. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. Print a week at a time or bind the year.

item.title: 2027 Planner Bundle: Printable and Digital Planners for Paper and Tablet
item.description: Three 2027 planners in one set: the Minimal Planner (year, monthly and 53 weekly pages), the Goals & Habits Planner (yearly goals, habit trackers and reviews) and the hyperlinked Digital Planner for tablets. 14 PDFs in A4, A5, US Letter and tablet landscape, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Monday or Sunday Start 2027 Planner Printable: Pick the Week Layout You Already Use
item.description: Some people read the week from Monday, others from Sunday. The 2027 Minimal Planner includes both versions of every page, so the month grids and 53 weekly pages line up with the way you already plan. Six PDFs: A4, A5 and US Letter, each in Monday start and Sunday start.

item.title: 2027 Monthly Planner Printable in A4, A5 and US Letter: Print Only the Months You Need
item.description: Print the whole year or just next month. The 2027 Minimal Planner has monthly two-page spreads: the month calendar, then blank holidays and birthdays fields, priorities and notes, so it works in any country. Six files are included: A4, A5 and US Letter, each in Monday or Sunday start. Print at 100% and double-sided to keep spreads together.

item.title: 2027 Year at a Glance Printable: Every Day of 2027 on One Page for Trips and Deadlines
item.description: See all 365 days of 2027 on one page, with a column for each month, so trips, deadlines, birthdays and school breaks are easy to mark and spot. It's the year-at-a-glance page of the 2027 Minimal Planner, which also has a year overview, monthly spreads and 53 weekly pages. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Rent Tracker Template: See Who Owes Rent, Partial Payments and Late Rent at a Glance
item.description: This rent tracker template matches each payment to what was due. Partial and late payments are flagged green, amber or red, with days late and a running balance per tenant. Part of a landlord spreadsheet that also covers deposits, lease ends, repairs and expenses for 1–10 units. Standard .xlsx, any currency. Record-keeping tool only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for 1–10 Units: Rent, Deposits, Leases and Repairs in One File
item.description: A simple rental property spreadsheet for small landlords with 1–10 long-term units. Log rent as it arrives and the dashboard shows collected vs expected, who owes what, net income per unit, leases ending soon and open repairs. Any currency, no subscription, no bank connection. Standard .xlsx with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: 2027 Minimal Planner Printable: Calm Year, Month and Week Pages With Nothing Extra
item.description: A calm, uncluttered 2027 planner for seeing your year, month and week at a glance. Clean lines, plenty of writing space and a small soft illustration each month. Includes a year overview, year at a glance, monthly two-page spreads, 53 weekly pages and key dates. Monday or Sunday start, in A4, A5 and US Letter. Prints well at home in colour or black and white.
